title: Knob is matched five times in settings.rs
body:
`settings.rs` matches `Knob` in `label`, `step_and_range`, `get`, the setter in `step`, and `show`. Three of those only look up constants: the label, the step and range, and the unit.

## Proposal

A const table `{ label, step, min, max, unit }` indexed by knob. Only the get/set pair stays as matches.
close_reason: RANGES in settings.rs holds each knob's label, step, range and unit; only get and the setter in step still match on Knob, in 0cb18e4.
